newsitem.title: USA: Disney Online to charge for kid website - Times.
newsitem.headline: Disney Online to charge for kid website - Times.

text.p: Walt Disney Co plans to charge $4.95 per month for access to its new Internet web site for children, the New York Times said Monday.
The site, called Disney Daily Blast, will feature an ABC News report for children and sports scores as well as puzzles and stories, the paper said.
Disney Online is a unit of Disney.
